entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • JSON Patch request body should use content-type application/json-patch+json #61956
  • Api Convention-related types missing from `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Core` `2.3.0` #61955
  • Signing 3rd party library with Microsoft cert in UB build #61954
  • Support validating dictionary values in validations generator #61953
  • ASPNetCore produces a stable-branded .msi for targeting packs and runtimes #61951
  • Rendering huge HTML report using HtmlRenderer outside of ASP.NET Core #61950
  • Cannot use Blazor WebAssembly debugging with OpenID Connect login due to unpredictable localhost port #61949

Closed

  • 📝 Issue: Native model binding support for mixed multipart/form-data and JSON payloads #61856
  • Placeholders are not updated in precompressed index.html files for published Blazor WebAssembly standalone apps #61937
  • [OpenApi] xml doc not used when endpoint delegate is async #61875
    10.0-preview5
  • Blazor WebAssembly browser debugging fails with UriFormatException using recent Chrome versions #61559
    9.0.x

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix sanitization of type names in validations generator #61952
    area-minimal, feature-validation
  • [release/9.0] Fixed devtools url used for debug with chrome and edge #61948
    9.0.x

Merged

  • Fixed devtools url used for debug with chrome and edge #61813
    area-blazor, community-contribution, 10.0-preview5
  • Support mapping <returns> to response description #61920
    feature-openapi, area-minimal, 10.0-preview5

Updated

  • Blazor - rendering metrics and tracing #61609
    area-blazor, 10.0-preview5
  • Bigred8982/issue 59462 OIDC par failure #61947
    area-auth, community-contribution
  • Add IMemoryPoolFactory and cleanup memory pool while idle #61554
    feature-iis, feature-kestrel, feature-httpsys, area-networking
  • Deduplicate group messages across connections #61810
    area-signalr, community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun
  • Follow-up: Improve stopping renderer, fix identity template #61633
    area-blazor, feature-prerendering, feature-blazor-navigation, .NET 10 Planning
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #61929
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:
